notes:
Short summary: Hightower LogicWorks is a mid-market B2B SaaS that builds an in-app product assistant for their buyer-facing product. Started on Hosted API (quick POC) then requested a Dedicated evaluation for predictable latency and data isolation. Key ask: Dedicated/VPC with SSO/SAML, SOC2 evidence, audit logs + configurable retention policies, KMS integration for key control, and option for regional data residency in us-west-2.

POC results (hosted): median latency ~120ms (512 tokens), cost ok for prototype but team wants committed pricing for production. They liked Redwood's batching and prefix cache demo; concerned about cold-starts for long-context flows.

Security review status: security intake completed 2026-03-08. Hightower's security/infra team requested SOC2 Type II report covering Dedicated control plane, SSO/SAML enabled SSO test account, audit log schema and retention policy (need per-token/log retention to 90/365 days options), and KMS/HSM integration details. They also asked about network peering options and whether the Dedicated control plane can be run in a private VPC with customer-managed subnets.

Quotes from stakeholders: "Need predictable p99 latency for chat flows — 600ms SLA target" (Head of Product). "We cannot accept vendor-managed key only — must support BYOK/KMS" (Security Lead).

Procurement notes: AE engaged procurement; want a 12-month reserved capacity commitment. Pricing conversation ongoing — SE provided a cost model for 3 Dedicated GPU nodes + burst. Requested an updated quote that includes SOC2 attestation add-on.

Internal action items: send SOC2 gap doc, provide sample audit log JSON schema, spin up SSO test tenant, share Dedicated network architecture diagram, updated committed pricing by 2026-03-18.

CRM shorthand and context: follow-up cadence = weekly, decision committee = Head of Product + SecOps + CFO, POC owner = Senior PM (Emily R.), legal review window ~3 weeks.
